name: Clear skies
summary: The month as a weather map: every conflict read from the chat is a cloud over its days and one weekend is open sky; drag the sun onto it, the clouds part and the trip goes on everyone's calendar.
useWhen: weeks of 'i can't that weekend' while planning a trip or a weekend away
finding the one weekend in a month that works for everyone, with the reasons people gave
dontUseWhen: finding an hour today or this week (use meeting-time or time-zone-table)
deciding where to go (use a poll)
a date already set (use an event)

params.title: string
params.first: weekday of the 1st, 0 Mon to 6 Sun
params.plan: what it becomes, e.g. Spring break trip
params.clouds: up to 10 x {name, what, from, to} conflicts by day of month
